translationRepairs: In the seventh year he was posted abroad as junior vice commissioner on Fujian's grain-supervision circuit.
In the seventh year he was posted out as junior vice commissioner on Fujian's grain-supervision circuit.
出為 marks departure from the capital to a domestic provincial post (福建督糧道僉事); 'abroad' wrongly implies foreign service, and 'posted out' correctly removes that error.
Near river transport routes, commoners are registered for labor — in tattered clothes and worn shoes, strength exhausted and sinews weary — while work rations may be swallowed in the middle.
Near river transport routes, commoners are registered for labor — in tattered clothes and worn shoes, strength exhausted and sinews weary — while work rations may be embezzled in the middle.
中飽 is the idiom for embezzlement / midstream appropriation of funds; 'swallowed' is a misleading calque, and 'embezzled' matches the sense already used in the idiomatic field.

The emperor ordered specific facts; Hongru again said: "I am registered in Qian'an. Under the Ming, poll silver was two qian for lowest-lower land, four qian for lower-middle land, and a little over seven fen per mu for upper land.

The emperor ordered specific facts; Hongru again said: "I am registered in Qian'an. Under the Ming, poll silver was two qian for the lowest-lower grade, four qian for the lower-middle grade, and a little over seven fen per mu for upper land.
丁銀…下下…下中…上地 contrasts ding/poll grades (下下、下中) with land (上地); rendering 下下/下中 as 'land' invents a land category the Chinese does not state.
The great outlet for expenditure is the army. the fundamental means of producing wealth is land.
The great outlet for expenditure is the army; the fundamental means of producing wealth is land.
用財大端惟兵，生財本計惟土 is one coordinate pair; the period-plus-lowercase break is ungrammatical English, and the semicolon matches the Chinese linkage.
To relieve the state budget, nothing is better than garrison farming. the court issued orders for civilian colonies.
To relieve the state budget, nothing is better than garrison farming; the court issued orders for civilian colonies.
莫善於屯田，朝廷下民屯之令 continues in one flow; the orphaned lowercase clause after a period is a real English error fixed by the semicolon.
Officials and runners were appointed, consuming much grain salary. the gain did not repay the cost, and before long abolition was requested.
Officials and runners were appointed, consuming much grain salary; the gain did not repay the cost, and before long abolition was requested.
設官置役…得不償失…請罷 is continuous narration; the period before lowercase 'the gain' is ungrammatical and the semicolon is the right join.
Recently Sichuan and Guizhou have entered the map. the lands gained require garrisons;
Recently Sichuan and Guizhou have entered the map; the lands gained require garrisons;
已入版圖，所得之地 is one thought; the period-plus-lowercase break is erroneous English corrected by the semicolon.
The counties around Shuntian guard the capital — a fundamental region. since the order for old settlers to enclose land, the principle of holding the heavy to control the light has been well applied.
The counties around Shuntian guard the capital — a fundamental region; since the order for old settlers to enclose land, the principle of holding the heavy to control the light has been well applied.
根本要地，自令舊人圈住 continues without a sentence break; the lowercase 'since' after a period is ungrammatical.
But the people of the metropolitan region have largely lost their regular livelihoods. land assigned elsewhere all has prior claims — how can they hold it as their own?
But the people of the metropolitan region have largely lost their regular livelihoods; land assigned elsewhere all has prior claims — how can they hold it as their own?
多失恆業，撥補他地 is coordinate explanation; the period before lowercase 'land' is a real English error.
Newly opened fertile soil yields rich profit. when the first efforts succeed, many will rush to follow.
Newly opened fertile soil yields rich profit; when the first efforts succeed, many will rush to follow.
獲利必饒，先事有獲 continues the same sentence; the period-plus-lowercase join must be a semicolon.
The ministry deliberated that Yunnan and Guizhou were not yet pacified, military funds were countless, while accounts could not be fixed in advance;
The ministry deliberated that Yunnan and Guizhou were not yet pacified, military funds were countless, and accounts could not be fixed in advance;
滇、黔未靖，兵餉無數，難以預定會計 lists additive reasons; 'while' falsely contrasts the third clause, and 'and' matches the Chinese.

That year at the grand evaluation Jian used the omission-report precedent to expose Shandong Liaocheng magistrate Zhang Shoulian's embezzled funds. referred for investigation. Shoulian was fined salary for failure to supervise clerks who took bribes;

That year at the grand evaluation Jian used the omission-report precedent to expose Shandong Liaocheng magistrate Zhang Shoulian's embezzled funds; referred for investigation. Shoulian was fined salary for failure to supervise clerks who took bribes;
下所司勘議 continues after 贓款; the orphaned lowercase 'referred' after a period is ungrammatical English.
Under Song and Yuan a prefecture was set at Haitan. the Ming abandoned it because of Japanese raids.
Under Song and Yuan a prefecture was set at Haitan; the Ming abandoned it because of Japanese raids.
明以倭患棄之 continues the Haitan history; the period before lowercase 'the Ming' is a broken sentence boundary.
Xianxia Ridge is the gateway into Fujian, bordering Jiangxi and Zhejiang. officials should be posted to control it and settlers recruited to fill the land so that no opening is left.
Xianxia Ridge is the gateway into Fujian, bordering Jiangxi and Zhejiang; officials should be posted to control it and settlers recruited to fill the land so that no opening is left.
與江西、浙江接壤，宜設官控制 is one recommendation; the period before lowercase 'officials' is ungrammatical.

In the eighteenth year Governor-General Zhang Changgeng and Governor Yang Maoxun memorialized recommending Jian as honest and capable. he assisted in supplying more than eight million in military funds for Yunnan and Guizhou, cleared tax arrears, opened wasteland, and removed long-standing abuses in coin casting.

In the eighteenth year Governor-General Zhang Changgeng and Governor Yang Maoxun memorialized recommending Jian as honest and capable; he assisted in supplying more than eight million in military funds for Yunnan and Guizhou, cleared tax arrears, opened wasteland, and removed long-standing abuses in coin casting.
疏薦楗廉幹，協濟滇、黔… continues Jian's recommended achievements; the period before lowercase 'he' wrongly splits the memorial content.
If unworthy men hold office, how can official discipline be clarified, the people's livelihood settled, while bandits stilled?
If unworthy men hold office, how can official discipline be clarified, the people's livelihood settled, and bandits stilled?
澄吏治、奠民生、息盜賊 is a three-part parallel; 'while' misrenders the third coordinated verb, and 'and' is required.
Soon after he requested retirement on grounds of illness. the emperor comforted him and kept him in office, sending an imperial physician to attend him.
Soon after he requested retirement on grounds of illness; the emperor comforted him and kept him in office, sending an imperial physician to attend him.
乞休，諭慰留，遣太醫視疾 is continuous court action; the period before lowercase 'the emperor' is a real English error.
The bandit sued the scholar for taking back the woman. the woman, citing the scholar's poverty and another marriage, testified for the bandit instead.
The bandit sued the scholar for taking back the woman; the woman, citing the scholar's poverty and another marriage, testified for the bandit instead.
盜以奪婦訟生，婦以…反為盜證 are linked clauses; the period before lowercase 'the woman' breaks the Chinese continuity.
The previous administration debated life and death. Pei investigated impartially and found the truth, had the woman executed by public notice and released the scholar from prison.
The previous administration debated life and death; Pei investigated impartially and found the truth, had the woman executed by public notice and released the scholar from prison.
前政論生死，裴廉得實 continues the case; the period before 'Pei' is an incorrect English sentence break.
He was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Punishments, transferred to censor of the Guangdong circuit, while again to supervising secretary of the Office of Rites.
He was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Punishments, transferred to censor of the Guangdong circuit, and again to supervising secretary of the Office of Rites.
再遷禮科給事中 is a further promotion in series; 'while again to' is ungrammatical and misrenders 再遷, whereas 'and again' is accurate.
An earthquake injured his foot. he lay at home nine years and died.
An earthquake injured his foot; he lay at home nine years and died.
傷於足，臥家九年，卒 is one biographical sequence; the period before lowercase 'he' is ungrammatical English.
Wencheng, Huguang governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, while provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.
Wencheng, Hubei governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, and provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.
湖北巡撫 is Hubei governor, not Huguang, and the list 文晟及…、…、… is additive, so 'while' must be 'and'.
Wencheng, Huguang governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, and provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.
Wencheng, Hubei governor Liu Dianheng, Pianyuan governor Zhao Shenqiao, and provincial commander Yu Yimo were each demoted or fined in varying degrees.
The literal likewise misreads 湖北 as Huguang; Hubei is required by the Chinese title.

Commoner Zhang San and others stole granary rice. Steppe Army commander Tuoheqi sent them to the Ministry of Punishments. Manchu minister Qi Shiwu proposed decapitation after imprisonment. Tingshu objected and proposed military exile.

Commoner Zhang San and others stole granary rice. Commander of the Infantry Brigade Tuoheqi sent them to the Ministry of Punishments. Manchu minister Qi Shiwu proposed decapitation after imprisonment. Tingshu objected and proposed military exile.
步軍統領 is the capital infantry / Nine Gates commandant, not a 'Steppe Army' commander; 'Commander of the Infantry Brigade' restores the office.

Commoner Zhang San and others stole granary rice; Steppe Army commander Tuoheqi sent them to the Ministry of Punishments; Manchu minister Qi Shiwu proposed decapitation after imprisonment; Tingshu objected and proposed military exile.

Commoner Zhang San and others stole granary rice; Commander of the Infantry Brigade Tuoheqi sent them to the Ministry of Punishments; Manchu minister Qi Shiwu proposed decapitation after imprisonment; Tingshu objected and proposed military exile.
The literal has the same error for 步軍統領; 'Steppe Army' is unsupported and must be corrected.
Wenxiang bandit Wang Gengyi also relied on magistrate Bai Cheng's advance collection of taxes and grain, gathered followers, while besieged the county seat;
Wenxiang bandit Wang Gengyi also relied on magistrate Bai Cheng's advance collection of taxes and grain, gathered followers, and besieged the county seat;
嘯聚圍縣城 coordinates gathering followers and besieging; 'while' wrongly contrasts the actions, and 'and' matches the Chinese.
Governor Zhang Shengduo and regional commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and also concealed the origins of the disturbance in their reports.
Governor Zhang Shengzuo and regional commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and also concealed the origins of the disturbance in their reports.
張聖佐 is Zhang Shengzuo (佐 = zuo); Shengduo is an unsupported romanization.
Governor Zhang Shengduo and regional commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and also concealed the origins of the disturbance in their reports.
Governor Zhang Shengzuo and regional commander Feng Junqian could not pacify them and also concealed the origins of the disturbance in their reports.
The literal likewise needs Shengzuo for 聖佐; Shengduo is wrong.
and former governor Li Xiling was also held accountable for subordinates' added levies provoking rebellion and sentenced to decapitation.
and former governor Li Xi was also held accountable for ordering subordinates to add levies that provoked rebellion and sentenced to decapitation.
李錫令屬吏加徵激變 parses as Li Xi ordering subordinates (令屬吏) to add levies; 'Li Xiling' wrongly absorbs 令 into the personal name.
and former governor Li Xiling was also held accountable for subordinates' added levies provoking rebellion and sentenced to decapitation.
and former governor Li Xi was also held accountable for ordering subordinates to add levies that provoked rebellion and sentenced to decapitation.
The literal has the same misparse; 令 is the verb 'ordered', not part of the name 李錫.
His son Jin passed the jinshi, served as palace aide, while also retired home on grounds of illness.
His son Jin passed the jinshi, served as palace aide, and also retired home on grounds of illness.
亦以告病家居 is additive (亦); 'while' falsely contrasts the career facts, and 'and also' matches the Chinese.
His son Xuan also passed the jinshi and served as clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
His son Yan also passed the jinshi and served as clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
綖 is Yan, not Xuan; the proposed personal name restores the correct reading of the graph.
His son Xuan also passed the jinshi and served as clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
His son Yan also passed the jinshi and served as clerk in the Ministry of Revenue.
The literal likewise misreads 綖 as Xuan; Yan is required.
